title: Software Developer - Shared Engineering
description: <p><strong>The Firm <br><br></strong>XTX Markets is a leading algorithmic trading firm which uses state-of-the-art machine learning technology to produce price forecasts for over 53,000 financial instruments across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and crypto. It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 300 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.  <br><br>We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures. <br><br>XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing well over 25,000 GPUs with more than 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities. <br><br>At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do. </p> <p><br><strong>The Role</strong> <br><br>Shared Engineering is a mixed-discipline platform team of around a dozen engineers (network engineers, Linux engineers, and software developers). The team owns the foundations that the firm's engineering runs on such as alerting, job scheduling, host inventory/monitoring, and the internal developer tooling for our monorepo. This includes shared libraries, build systems and CI/CD infrastructure. <br><br>Our aim is to give the firm's engineers leverage: fewer manual steps, delivery that is fast and predictable, and teams who can self-serve rather than raising a ticket and waiting. We have many initiatives in flight at once, so judgement about which thing to work on matters nearly as much as building it well. <br><br>This is a software-developer role on the team focused on developer experience and platform software: building the tools, services, and libraries that make everyone else's engineering faster and more reliable. A growing part of that remit is how the firm's engineers adopt AI and coding-assistant tooling. Recent work includes our self-service network configuration tools, sandboxing and gateway services for coding assistants, and pulling host inventory data into a single source of truth. <br><br><br><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working primarily in Go, build and own platform services and internal tooling end-to-end, from design through to production. </li> <li>Improve developer experience by reducing friction in the build/CI/CD path, strengthen shared libraries. </li> <li>Help shape how the wider firm adopts AI/coding-assistant tooling safely and effectively, integrating it into workflows and building guardrails and tooling around it. </li> <li>Collaborate with the network and Linux engineers to understand what the infrastructure needs in order to scale and be managed, then expose it cleanly in software. </li> <li>Mentor and share knowledge, improving teammates' skills and making sure others can maintain and build on the systems you develop. </li> <li>Review and raise standards by thoughtful code review, sensible judgement on where to block versus where to let things flow, and a pragmatic sense of the right work to be doing right now. </li> <li>Take part in on-call once up-to-speed, troubleshooting problems that span several technical domains across current and legacy infrastructure. <br> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential attributes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong software-engineering fundamentals and production experience owning services end-to-end. You've worked in a monorepo or a serious build/release setup and made it better. </li> <li>A track record of delivering: shipping, closing out, and not letting scope or polish stall a deliverable. </li> <li>Good written and verbal communication, and the collaborative instinct to treat non-developer engineers as first-class colleagues. <br> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable attributes <br><br></strong>Things we'd like to see. description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Your Mission As a Customer Value Partner at Hawk, you own the customer relationship from first scoping through implementation and into ongoing growth: one name, one accountable owner, no handoffs between a CSM, an Engagement Manager, and a PM along the way. You run delivery according to Hawk's best practices and methodology, and you're judged on whether the customer hits the outcomes we promised. At the core of the role is understanding what value actually means for each customer, in their own numbers, against their own objectives, and then building it, not reporting on it after the fact. You're not a project manager who bends to every customer's internal governance model. You're the person who proves the value Hawk delivers, then converts that proof into retained and expanded revenue. Design and drive joint success plans that align Hawk's delivery to each client's real business objectives and regulatory context, not a generic template. title: AI Software Engineer
description: About ExTrac ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight. Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai . The Role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join ExTrac's AI team, building Co-Analyst and the analytical AI features around it. Co-Analyst is a user-facing multi-agent system that works alongside intelligence analysts to research and write reports. A planning loop decomposes an analyst's question, fans work out to sub-agents, and assembles the results into a report where every claim traces back to the chunk of source it came from. Underneath sits hybrid retrieval over a large unstructured corpus: analyst intent translated into structured filters, combined with keyword and dense vector search, across multiple languages and media types. The agent work is the centrepiece but not the whole job. In a single quarter the work spans agent orchestration, retrieval, graph analytics, and long-running streaming pipelines, alongside the services and databases underneath them. You will own well-defined features and components end to end across a Python and Go codebase, working alongside senior engineers who set technical direction, the data team who own the ingestion pipelines, and a research-focused ML team who train and evaluate the models we integrate and serve. The loop is short: product brings an idea, often recent and unproven, and our job is to spike an implementation and take it to a production feature. New features land close to weekly. This hire exists to add capacity on the AI team's hard problems: an engineer who can independently deliver well-scoped features and components, and who is building towards owning more of the system end to end. What the job involves Agentic and analytical AI features Build and improve components of the agent loop itself: context assembly, tool selection, and sub-agent orchestration, with guidance from senior engineers on the team. Build the analytical AI features that sit alongside it, from network construction through to the summaries analysts read. Help prove that changes are improvements, running experiments against live analyst traffic behind feature flags. Contribute to agreeing what "better" means for a capability, and flag honestly when the evidence says a promising approach is not working. Work with embeddings as more than a retrieval concern. The same vectors drive network construction and community detection. Work within a model-agnostic design, swapping models and embeddings on the back of the ML team's evaluations rather than being locked to one. Service design and delivery Take a well-defined problem, clarify requirements with your lead or a senior engineer, and ship it to production with regular check-ins rather than close oversight. Own features and components end to end within a single system, contributing to system design and architecture discussions and taking on more of the design work as you build context. Build and maintain APIs used by internal teams and customers, following established contracts and versioning conventions. Work with the storage layer as a design concern rather than an implementation detail: schema, indexing strategy, and access patterns, across relational, document, and vector stores. Production engineering Build and operate supporting services across Python and Go, with growing ownership of design, deployment, and operations as you build track record. Help hold agent workflows to production standards for latency, cost, and reliability, in a system where non-determinism is a given. Build and operate long-running streaming pipelines, including the caching and recovery behaviour that makes them survivable. Working with analysts, product, and the ML team Work directly with the analysts who use our products, turning what they hit in practice into changes in the system. Iterate quickly against a live stream of product requests, flagging where they collide with longer-horizon capability work. Partner with the ML team on agentic approaches, helping take proven concepts to production and working through the engineering, performance, and reliability problems a research implementation does not have to. Help integrate and serve the models they train, and contribute to the production infrastructure their evaluation frameworks run on. You should apply if You have built and worked on production backend systems, and you want to keep doing that. You will spend more of your time in Python and Go services, databases, and APIs than in a prompt file, and you know the difference between something that demos well and something that holds up under production load, latency, and cost. You can work independently on well-defined problems, and know when to flag ambiguity or ask for input rather than guessing. When the obvious approach fails, you look for another one before escalating. You are curious about agentic frameworks and comfortable working without one. Experience with them is useful, but we build most of our own orchestration, because off-the-shelf abstractions have not survived our requirements around evaluation, control, and production performance. You can take a recent technique or paper, help spike an implementation, and reason clearly about whether it is worth taking further. You do not trust a change until you have measured it. Reaching for the evaluation is instinct rather than afterthought. You actively seek feedback and act on it, and you look for opportunities to pair with and learn from the engineers around you. You want to work on things that matter. Our software sits underneath decisions taken by governments, defence organisations, and institutions operating where being wrong or late carries real consequences. Where this role can take you Grow into full ownership. Strong performance means owning larger features and whole services end to end, writing the technical designs others build on, and leading reviews rather than only taking part in them. That is the path to Senior, and it is a path we will actively work with you on. Breadth rather than a narrow track. The work follows the problem, which means agent orchestration one month and pipeline, retrieval, or infrastructure work the next. Engineers here have the opportunity to build depth across several areas rather than being funnelled into one. Work on a class of system nobody has settled yet. There are established patterns for running web services and for training models. There are none yet for operating agentic systems in production: controlling cost and latency, making non-deterministic behaviour dependable, and knowing when a change is genuinely an improvement. You will be helping work those out, and that experience is still rare. Take on a different class of problem. Making our systems work inside FedRAMP environments is a major upcoming project, and engineering under that kind of constraint is a skill set that stays with you. Requirements Due to the nature of our work and the clients we support, applicants must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. We are currently only able to consider applicants who are nationals of a NATO member state, Australia, or New Zealand. 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade services with solid test coverage, and experience owning features or components end to end within a larger system. Proficiency in building services in Python, with working knowledge of Go or the ability to pick it up quickly. Some exposure to agentic systems, LLM applications, or retrieval running in production, or clear evidence you would pick them up fast. A good understanding of distributed systems and databases, including writing asynchronous code that performs under load. Experience with cloud infrastructure and the CI/CD pipelines around it. Comfortable working with trunk-based deployment. Comfortable being handed a symptom rather than a diagnosis. Given a suspected memory leak, you would profile it, find the cause, and fix it, asking for support when you get stuck. Able to take a well-defined requirement and scope a technical approach from it, asking clarifying questions up front rather than assuming. You communicate clearly in writing and can produce documentation colleagues can follow, and you look for a way through rather than concluding something cannot be done. Breadth and curiosity across the stack: an interest in deployment pipelines, database behaviour, security and AI guardrails, and in validating analytical outputs and feeding analyst feedback into requirements. You pick up unfamiliar tools quickly rather than needing prior expertise in a specific one. Desirable Experience with retrieval systems and large-scale vector database performance (Elastic). Experience with graph or network analysis at scale. Experience building retrieval or analysis that works across multiple languages. Experience with infrastructure as code, streaming pipelines, and search infrastructure. Experience operating multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a hard requirement. Experience working in compliance-constrained environments. A significant upcoming project is making our systems work within FedRAMP environments. Interview Process Initial Intro Interview with Hiring Manager - 30 Minutes Technical Assessment - 1 hour Competency-based Interview - 1 hour Founder interview - 30 Minutes Benefits Competitive salary based on skills and experience. A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions. Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme. £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays. Flexible working. The team is typically in our central London office two days a week, and you are welcome to come in up to five. title: Product Manager
description: <div> <p><strong>Weekly office requirement:</strong> Monday/Wednesday weekly <br><strong>Employment type:</strong> Permanent<br><strong>Seniority level: </strong>Mid-senior</p> <p>At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for a<strong> Product Manager </strong>to play a key role in our <strong>User Management (Revenue </strong><strong>& Enablement) </strong>team in <strong>London</strong>. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.</p> <br> <h1>Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔</h1> <p>As our Product Manager you'll own the systems that make GWI's subscription and consumption business run, such as billing, metering, user plans, feature access, product analytics and user messaging. It's the layer everything else sits on. Get it right and GWI can price, package and sell in new ways.</p> <br> <p>Two big pieces of work sit at the heart of this role. The first is billing for our consumption products, which is an area we're actively developing, and one you'll help shape. The second is making our internal tools talk to each other properly, so user data flows consistently between them and Salesforce, and everyone across the business is working from the same picture. Most of your stakeholders are internal - Revenue Operations, Finance, Business Intelligence, Client Success and Engineering - with some direct client contact along the way. You'll lead one squad of front-end and back-end engineers and a designer, alongside the PM and Engineers in our sister squad, Identity & Access - together you cover the whole of User Management.</p> <br> <p>A few things you’ll be responsible for: </p> <br>👉 Connecting our internal user management tools with Salesforce and each other, so data flows consistently and user information is mapped the same way everywhere <p>👉 Billing for our consumption products - metering, API usage, payment flows and user plans</p> <p>👉 Customer feature flags, access and management - who can see what, and why</p> <p>👉 Product analytics - event firing, sign-up flow data, usage data - so the business can see what's happening and act on it</p> <p>👉 Building the roadmap from client feedback, internal stakeholder input and usage analytics, and prioritising the most valuable work</p> <p>👉 Scoping the work and owning how your squad delivers it<br><br>It’s also fun; shaking things up is what working for GWI is all about. You’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment.</p> <br> <h1>What do I need to bring with me? 🧳</h1> <p>You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:</p> <br> <p>👉 You've shipped products at a B2B company</p> <p>👉 You've built complex roadmaps with cross-functional dependencies, and you can balance multiple priorities without losing the plot</p> <p>👉 You make informed decisions at pace, even when the picture isn't complete</p> <p>👉 You're a strong problem solver, negotiator and influencer — you get alignment without needing authority</p> <p>👉 You explain complex things clearly to very different audiences: execs, engineers, customers</p> <p>👉 You ask questions and draw knowledge out of your team to find the right engineering and design solutions</p> <p>👉 You make informed decisions at pace, even when the picture isn't complete, and you're happy taking a big initiative and running with it</p> <p>👉 Bonus points if you've worked with Salesforce before, or with tools that need to sync data between systems and internal user management systems.</p> <p><br>Equally important is attitude. We want people who think big (to make an impact), ask why (to find a better way), and show respect (to everyone, at every level, all the time). Those are our values, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.</p> <br> <h1>Why Join Us</h1> <p>👉 You'll work on how GWI packages its consumption products - commercial problems with real weight behind them</p> <p>👉 Your squad owns infrastructure the whole company depends on, so the work gets noticed</p> <p>👉 You'll build relationships across the business, from Finance to Engineering to the Exec team</p> <p>👉 You'll learn from a senior PM who knows this space, with room to run your own squad your way</p> </div> <p> </p> <h1>Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 🫶</h1> <p>Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.</p> <p>As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.</p> <p>We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.</p> <p>At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.</p> <p> </p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/2g0akAyAlUU?si=dIgYyrKaAlNZK-NQ" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>#li-hybrid<br>#LI-VS01</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Sales Engineer
description: Technical Sales Engineer This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens. About us Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit. We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. description: At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world. The Role: CoMind One measures the brain from outside the skull. Fifteen scientists (optical physicists, signal processing specialists, physiologists) turn raw optical interference signals into continuous measurements of cerebral physiology a clinician can act on. What slows them down isn't the science; it's the engineering around it. The last head-to-head comparison of two novel methods took six weeks, and most of that had nothing to do with the methods. You'd design the architecture that fixes this: how data, compute, pipelines and evaluation fit together, and the standards that hold it in place. None of it exists yet in any deliberate form, so the shape is an open question. When it works, a scientist describes the comparison they want and gets back metrics, plots and a reproducible record from one command, or one prompt. At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. Responsibilities: Problems, not specifications. How they get solved is yours to decide. Reprocessing. Change one stage of the pipeline and you currently pay for a full re-run. Re-running a six-month-old analysis with new parameters should be routine and cheap. Evaluation. Comparison and simulation harnesses are rebuilt bespoke every time. They should be something a scientist calls, not something a scientist commissions, including scientists who don't write code, and agents running analysis strands on their behalf. Compute and data access. Reproducible environments, sensibly-sized cloud resource, and datasets you can find and trust without asking whoever made them. Engineering standards. Testing, CI and repository structure across a codebase written largely by scientists. Knowing where to enforce and where to reduce friction instead matters more than the tooling does. title: Senior Network Engineer - Low Latency Trading
description:
<p>The Networks team designs, builds and maintains all the communications infrastructure that allows our high-capacity, low-latency trading and data research environments to run 24/7.  This network spans over 25 countries and 100 locations. We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with experience designing and managing large environments to fulfill the high-performance and availability requirements of a premiere algorithmic trading firm operating in global financial markets. </p> <p>This position requires both project management and deep technical skills. Working together with some of the brightest minds in our industry, you’ll be responsible for everything from product selection and design to routing configuration and troubleshooting. You will work closely with our Systems and Trading Operations teams as well as others at HRT to build, manage, and monitor our low-latency trading network. You’ll have broad responsibilities with freedom to analyze and solve problems, and your solutions will have an immediate impact on our worldwide operations. </p> <p>We’re looking for someone with a love for technology and an excitement for tackling big picture problems. You will work on a wide variety of projects to enhance the performance and capacity of the global trading and research platforms and contribute to both high-level strategy and the technical nitty-gritty of our global network architecture.</p> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related IT field</li> <li>5-10 years of relevant experience, preferably in low-latency and high-frequency trading environments.</li> <li>In depth understanding of common layer 2 and layer 3 network protocols and best practices; working knowledge of OSPF, BGP, PIM, IGMP</li> <li>Experience managing Arista, Cisco, and other common networking devices on a day-to-day basis</li> <li>Familiarity with low-latency microwave networks and/or optical transmission systems, such as Adva, Ciena is desirable</li> <li>Experience in designing enterprise networks, capacity planning, and full lifecycle project management</li> <li>Experience with packet decoding and analysis tools such as tcpdump and Wireshark</li> <li>Excellent oral and written communication skills: able to distill complicated issues into clear and concise terms and to create and maintain effective technical documentation</li> <li>Experience with Unix/Linux command line utilities and networking stack</li> <li>Excellent troubleshooting skills on a wide range of networking issues, including common ethernet LAN problems, multicast market data distribution, and global WAN</li> <li>Understanding of basic power consumption and cooling issues in a datacenter environment</li> <li>Knowledge of fiber optics technology and cabling standards. Ability to sort through specs and make recommendations on appropriate purchases</li> <li>Willingness and ability to solve small technical problems in the field yourself.</li> <li>You have excellent collaboration skills and a willingness to admit mistakes.</li> <li>Familiarity with firewalls (including Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet), VPNs and NAT</li> <li>Familiarity with configuration management tools, such as Ansible or Salt is desirable</li> <li>Familiarity with Python, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, GitHub is desirable</li> <li>Familiarity with public cloud networks, such as AWS, GCP, Azure, is desirable</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content. </span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!</span></p></div><p><strong>About Expert Insights:</strong><br>Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. AlphaSense’s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market’s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. Expert Insights is quickly becoming a table-stakes solution for institutional investors to choose the right companies to invest in while gaining rapid adoption among all other consumers of market intelligence from sell-side research and banking, consultancies, and large corporations.</p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></strong></p> <p>As a Sector Lead on our TMT (Technology, Media and Telecoms) Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.</p> <p>You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. emerging market themes and client information needs.</p> <p>You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>the Director of Research to develop and maintain a strategic sector roadmap, which you will such as white papers, webinars, internal and external presentations.</li> <li>Establish and maintain feedback loops with call takers and project teams to enhance the quality and insight of future title: Senior Enterprise Risk Manager (Contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-teams="true">Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Our specialist investment capabilities span multiple strategies across private equity, infrastructure and real assets, and private credit. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide</span></p> <p>For further details please visit <a href="http://www.pantheon.com">www.pantheon.com</a></p></div><p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong></p> <p>The Senior Enterprise Risk Manager will support the Enterprise Risk function on a fixed-term basis to support the delivery of key regulatory and risk management initiatives. The role will focus on supporting compliance with regulatory requirements relating to PIN and PINT (Provision 34), advancing the firm's Internal Controls System (ICS) framework, and further enhancing operational risk management capabilities across the business.<br>The position will report directly to the Head of Enterprise Risk and will work closely with senior stakeholders across all business functions to strengthen risk governance, controls documentation, and regulatory readiness.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Internal Controls System (ICS) Framework</p> <ul> <li>Support the enhancement, and implementation of the firm's Internal Controls System (ICS) framework.</li> <li>Partner with business owners to identify, document, and assess key processes, risks, and controls.</li> <li>Drive the centralisation of risk and control documentation to meet evolving regulatory expectations.</li> <li>Ensure risk and control inventories are complete, accurate, and maintained within the firm's designated governance platform.</li> <li>Challenge and validate control design and effectiveness to support a robust control environment.</li> </ul> <p>Regulatory Programme Delivery</p> <ul> <li>Support the delivery of regulatory commitments relating to PIN and PINT, including requirements under Provision 34.</li> <li>Coordinate with first and second line stakeholders to gather, review, and evidence regulatory deliverables.</li> <li>Assist in preparing materials, documentation, and management reporting for regulatory reviews and internal governance forums.</li> <li>Track progress against regulatory milestones and identify risks, issues, and dependencies impacting delivery.</li> </ul> <p>Enterprise and Operational Risk Management</p> <ul> <li>Support the continued enhancement of the enterprise and operational risk management frameworks (such as Fraud and Operational Resilience frameworks).</li> <li>Identify control gaps, emerging risks, and opportunities for framework improvement.</li> <li>Support incident, issue, and remediation management activities where required.</li> <li>Support and management of data privacy related framework enhancements </li> </ul> <p>Stakeholder Engagement</p> <ul> <li>Build strong working relationships with business leaders and risk owners across the organisation.</li> <li>Provide guidance and challenge on risk and controls best practice.</li> <li>Facilitate workshops and working sessions to support process mapping, risk assessment, and controls documentation activities.</li> <li>Deliver clear and concise reporting to senior management and governance committees.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Knowledge and Experience Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience within Enterprise Risk, Operational Risk, Internal Controls, or Risk Transformation within financial services (incl. operational resilience, outsourcing, or third-party risk frameworks).</li> <li>Experience supporting risk framework enhancement, or governance programmes.</li> <li>Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), process mapping, and controls documentation.</li> <li>Experience implementing or enhancing Internal Controls System (ICS) frameworks.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of financial services regulatory expectations and governance requirements.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience partnering with senior business stakeholders and control owners.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently, manage multiple workstreams, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Experience within asset management, private markets, banking, or investment management environments would be advantageous.</li> <li>Experience supporting regulatory engagements or remediation programmes.</li> <li>Knowledge of governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) systems.</li> <li>Experience developing centralised risk and controls libraries.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. You may be required to perform other job-related duties as reasonably requested by your manager.</strong></p> <p><strong>Pantheon is an Equal Opportunities employer, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't perfectly align we'd still encourage you to apply.</strong></p> <p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive with German
description: <h1><strong>About the Team</strong></h1> <p>The Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by empowering operators to take control of their guest relationships. We’re a passionate, high-performing group of go-getters who act as trusted advisors to restaurants and hospitality groups around the world. We take a consultative approach to sales—identifying business gaps, crafting thoughtful solutions, and helping operators reduce reliance on third-party networks. We believe in the power of hospitality, and we’re proud to partner with businesses to streamline operations and deliver magical guest experiences every day.</p> <h1><strong>About the Role</strong></h1> <p>As an Account Executive, you’ll work directly with restaurants and hospitality groups to understand their business needs and recommend the best-fit SevenRooms solutions—from reservations and table management to online ordering and marketing automation. You’ll drive new business by adding operators to the platform and working closely with our onboarding and account teams to ensure a smooth and enthusiastic transition. This role plays a key part in helping hospitality operators thrive, combining strategic thinking, relationship-building, and product knowledge to deliver real impact.</p> <h1><strong>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Build and Manage a Sales Pipeline</strong>. Identify and engage prospective restaurants and hospitality groups to grow your book of business.</li> <li><strong>Showcase the Platform.</strong> Present the value of SevenRooms through compelling demos and conversations that help operators understand how we can support their success.</li> <li><strong>Lead Sales from Start to Finish.</strong> Own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and pitching to negotiation, contracting, and go-live support.</li> <li><strong>Deliver Live Product Demos.</strong> Conduct live, engaging product walkthroughs both virtually and in person when needed.</li> <li><strong>Be a Trusted Partner.</strong> Build strong relationships with prospects and clients, always advocating for their success and acting as a true advisor throughout the process.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>We’re excited about you because…</strong></h1> <ul> <li>You have 3+ years of experience in hospitality technology sales</li> <li>You’re confident presenting to clients both in person and virtually</li> <li>You’re self-driven and comfortable working independently, whether in the office or remotely</li> <li>You’re tech-savvy and quick to pick up new tools and platforms</li> <li>You’re results-oriented and bring energy and focus to your daily work</li> <li>You’ve worked with tools like Salesforce, Outreach, or similar systems</li> <li>You have a background in hospitality or restaurants (a big plus!)</li> <li>You’re open to occasional travel into key markets to connect with clients face-to-face</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>You speak fluent German and English</strong></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p style="font-weight: 500;">Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only</p> <p>We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using <a href="https://getcovey.com/product/covey-scout-inbound">Covey Scout for Inbound</a> from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using <a href="https://getcovey.com/product/covey-scout-inbound">Covey Scout for Inbound</a> again on June 29, 2024.</p> <p>The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: <a style="text-decoration: underline;" href="https://getcovey.com/nyc-local-law-144">Covey</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About SevenRooms</strong></h1> <p>In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.</p> <p>With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.</p> <p>In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.</p> <p>As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.</p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Shape the test strategy that proves Graphcore firmware is ready for production hardware.</p> <p>As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will lead firmware QA across Graphcore’s next-generation hardware platforms. You will verify the low level software behind boot, configuration and monitoring.</p> <p>Your tests will protect production firmware quality, from power sequencing to hardware interfaces and telemetry. You will create reliable gates for firmware used across teams and systems.</p> <p>You will design test infrastructure, build high coverage tests and debug issues with hardware and analysers. You will also guide best practice while staying close to the code.</p> <p>This role needs technical breadth, embedded systems depth and calm ownership of difficult problems. You will shape how firmware quality scales at Graphcore.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>You will join the Firmware QA team within System Software QA. The team validates low level software for complete boot, configuration and monitoring of Graphcore silicon and hardware platforms.</p> <p>Work happens close to hardware, across firmware, software and platform teams. You will turn requirements and use cases into acceptance tests that protect production quality.</p> <p>Decisions are shaped by evidence, technical discussion and clear ownership. You will speak up, set standards and mentor engineers through practical, hands-on leadership.</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p>· Significant experience in firmware qualification across complex embedded systems.<br>· Deep understanding of real time embedded systems and complex boot logic.<br>· Experience working with hardware, debuggers and analysers.<br>· Strong understanding of silicon and hardware interfaces, including I2C, I3C, SMBus, SPI, PCIe, DDR and power management.<br>· Experience with CI/CD, build tools and modern testing practices.<br>· Ability to debug cross-layer issues, drive root-cause investigations and communicate complex technical concepts clearly.</p> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p>Ready to shape firmware quality for Graphcore’s next-generation hardware platforms? Apply now to join the team.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Platform Engineer, Fanatics Markets - UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow - from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.</p> <h4><strong>Role Overview</strong></h4> <p>As a <strong>Staff Platform Engineer,</strong> you operate with broad organizational impact. You will set technical direction, design durable platform abstractions, and partner closely with senior engineers, engineering managers, and product leadership to ensure our platform enables rapid innovation without compromising stability, security, or compliance.</p> <p>This role blends deep hands-on engineering expertise with systems thinking and influence. You will lead complex cross-team initiatives, establish best-in-class platform standards, and mentor engineers while remaining directly involved in building and operating core platform capabilities.</p> <p>On the engineering side, we're pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have gone beyond experimentation—who actively use Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality standards. If you have strong opinions about AI-augmented development workflows backed by real experience, we want to talk with you.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Define and document enterprise-wide standards for AI integration, establishing prompt engineering patterns and validation frameworks that scale development velocity without compromising architectural integrity.</li> <li>Orchestrate the identification of AI-generated code pitfalls—such as security vulnerabilities and over-abstraction—while quantifying the business impact through PR velocity and quality metrics.</li> <li>Lead the design and evolution of highly available, scalable infrastructure, ensuring the platform remains resilient under the demands of multi-disciplinary engineering teams.</li> <li>Architect robust CI/CD ecosystems and developer tooling, focusing on eliminating friction in the software delivery lifecycle and driving organization-wide productivity.</li> <li>Serve as a subject matter expert for platform security, implementing sophisticated safeguards and compliance standards to protect the integrity of the firm’s systems.</li> <li>Drive the strategic roadmap for system observability, implementing advanced monitoring, tracing, and alerting architectures to ensure peak operational reliability.</li> <li>Act as a primary technical liaison between engineering, product, and quantitative teams to translate complex requirements into scalable, innovative platform solutions.</li> <li>Foster a culture of high performance and continuous learning, mentoring engineers on best practices, managing incident response strategies, and advocating for the adoption of transformative technologies</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Qualifications</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>8 plus years of experience in platform engineering or DevOps, title: Director Vertical Marketing - Energy & Defence
description: Light is building the financial foundation for businesses operating across entities and currencies, with AI agents doing routine work and people shaping how the system operates. You’ll own market understanding, positioning and the marketing pipeline for Energy and Defence, partnering closely with the relevant Sales Managers and our shared Product Marketing, Demand Generation and Field Marketing teams. Build a shared segment plan with Sales, testing opportunities across energy developers, operators, services and technology businesses, and defence technology and service suppliers with project or contract complexity. Work with Product and customer teams to prioritise needs based on evidence and keep market promises grounded in what Light can deliver. Turn early wins into a repeatable approach. Build customer relationships, lead interviews and capture outcomes that become references and case studies where appropriate. Use win/loss learning to sharpen our targeting, message, partner strategy, events and campaigns. What you’ll bring Around ten years of marketing experience, with a strong foundation in industry or product marketing and evidence of building markets and delivering commercial results. Experience owning a marketing pipeline from planning through execution and reporting. You can build a model, understand funnel performance and explain what needs to change. An established ability to speak publicly and tell a compelling industry story, whether on stage, in a customer interview or in conversation with analysts, partners and industry media. Experience building trusted relationships in anadjacent complex B2B sector where domain credibility, long buying cycles and multiple stakeholders matter. A record of partnering closely with Sales, including training direct reps and SDRs to understand a segment and sell into it with credibility. Experience translating customer needs into clear sector requirements with Product Marketing and Product, distinguishing a recurring market need from a one-off request. Strong analytical curiosity and practical experience using AI to investigate performance, test explanations and improve decisions. You verify the output and can explain the reasoning behind your recommendations. Strong writing and storytelling skills, the judgement to challenge assumptions, and a willingness to do the work yourself: interview customers, map the market, write the message, build the campaign and examine the results. You’ll bring enough sector understanding to earn credibility quickly, alongside the curiosity to keep learning. We’re looking for someone who can build a market and a repeatable approach, with customer evidence behind both. What success looks like Clear priorities for Energy and Defence, positioning that resonates with buyers, and a growing marketing pipeline. Weekly reporting explains what is happening, why it is happening and what the team will do next. Sales reps and SDRs understand the commercial, procurement and operating nuances of each segment and have the training, content, customer proof and partner routes to progress deals. Customers and specialist partners strengthen our presence in the market, while Product Marketing and Product have a clear, evidence-backed view of the requirements that matter most. You’ll assess progress through qualified pipeline, conversion, sales-cycle performance and customer outcomes, working with Sales and customer teams to understand delivery effort and time to value. How we work Light’s values are speed, simplicity and transparency. We make decisions when the evidence is sufficient, keep ownership clear and share progress and problems early. We expect leaders to raise the quality of the work, help colleagues succeed and use AI to remove unnecessary effort. This is an opportunity to shape priority markets from the beginning, with direct influence on how Light understands customers, takes its product to market and develops its offering. The good stuff 🏢 In-office culture, high talent density. 💸 Competitive salary. 🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays. 🚀 Define what winning looks like in a vertical from the very first deal. 🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, Munich, NY, Paris, and wherever Energy & Defence customers, partners and industry events take us. 🥳 Off-sites twice a year. title: People Operations Associate (AI and Automation)
description: Hi, I’m Ellie, People Lead at hx. I joined hx in January 2025 as a Senior People Partner and have recently stepped into the People Lead role. Outside of work, I’m an F1 fan and dog mum, so I’m no stranger to fast-paced environments or the occasional pit stop for walkies. Our People team supports all things people at hx, from performance and engagement to the systems, insights and day-to-day operations that help our teams do their best work. We’re growing the team and looking for someone to own our People reporting and analytics, while helping keep the operational side of the function running smoothly. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, wants to make a real impact and is excited to help shape how the People team grows alongside the business. Interested? Read more about the role and life at hx below. About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the People team Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it. Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure. You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room.. What you'll be doing Build the AI tooling that our People and Talent function runs on. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side. Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are. Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves. Learn our people processes properly, starting with onboarding, payroll data integrity and the performance cycle, then rebuild the parts that depend on manual effort. Support our performance review cycles in Lattice and our engagement surveys, help analyse what comes out of them, and automate the parts that should not need a person. Help keep our HRIS data accurate, including records, reporting and system troubleshooting. What you'll need to have done Built and shipped something with AI that other people used, whether that is an agent, a script, a tool, a bot or a side project. Got past the first version. We will ask how you tested it, what it got wrong with real users and what you changed as a result. If you have a long list of things you have experimented with, we want to hear what each one taught you. Worked with more than one model or platform, and formed a view on what each is good for. Worked with a real dataset, cleaned it up, and drawn a conclusion you could defend. Been responsible for keeping a system or record accurate, whether that is a tracker, a membership list, a codebase or admin for a part-time role. Handled something that needed to stay confidential, or can show us how you think about handling sensitive information. Genuine interest in how organisations work, and the willingness to learn a domain where the detail matters and the consequences of getting it wrong land on real colleagues. You're unlikely to thrive here if You struggle to adapt to change or ambiguity, or find it difficult to collaborate across diverse teams. You're not energised by a culture that values ownership, feedback, and continuous learning. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation This role sits within a £40,000 - £55,000 salary range. At hx, we're committed to salary transparency, you'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, and our Talent Partner will share more detail with you during initial conversations. We're also working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team. Next steps If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! You will lead and develop a team of market leaders, setting clear strategic direction while empowering them to translate Bumble's global strategy into locally relevant, insight-led market plans. You are a strategic and empathetic leader who sets a high bar for both thinking and execution. You know how to coach teams, navigate complexity, challenge established approaches, make difficult prioritization decisions, and create an environment where people have the clarity, autonomy, and support to do their best work. Lead and develop a high-performing team of market leaders, setting clear direction and empowering them to own outcomes. Drive alignment across the portfolio, ensuring teams stay focused on priorities, share learnings, and adapt quickly as business needs evolve. Regularly assess performance across the portfolio and make deliberate choices about where to prioritize, where to invest, where to optimize. Establish clear success measures across the portfolio and champion a strong culture of measurement and learning. Use performance and consumer insights to continuously challenge assumptions and evolve market strategies. Build strong partnerships with Global Marketing, Creative, Media, Product Marketing, Growth, Communications, Partnerships, Research & Insights and other cross-functional teams, ensuring Core Market priorities are clearly represented and incorporated into broader company plans. Communicate portfolio performance, priorities, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership, translating complexity into clear recommendations and decisions. Build a high performing and inclusive team culture grounded in trust, accountability, openness, and mutual respect. Act as a senior leader within the broader International organization, contributing beyond the Core Markets portfolio by sharing frameworks, market learnings, leadership practices, and strategic perspectives that raise the effectiveness of the wider team. KEY SKILLS Bachelor's degree; MBA or Master's is a plus +12 years of experience in brand, integrated, or strategic marketing, ideally in consumer tech, lifestyle, or culturally-driven brands. Significant experience in senior brand, integrated, strategic, or market marketing leadership roles, ideally within consumer technology, lifestyle, entertainment, or other culturally driven brands. Proven experience leading multiple markets, business units, or a complex portfolio, with accountability for setting strategy, determining priorities, and driving measurable business and brand outcomes. Strong people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to coach and develop high performing teams and managers. Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to move between the portfolio level view and individual market dynamics and determine what matters most. Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex market challenges by synthesizing information and translating those insights into clear strategic choices. Strong commercial and analytical judgment, with experience using data, measurement, and ROI frameworks to inform prioritization, investment decisions, and changes in strategy. Deep understanding of integrated marketing and the role of brand, media, creators, partnerships, communications, experiential, product marketing, and growth in driving both brand and business outcomes. Understanding of international marketing and the balance between global consistency and meaningful local relevance. Proven ability to influence and align senior cross functional stakeholders. Excellent executive communication skills. Ability to operate effectively in a fast moving environment. Excellent relationship building, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. ABOUT YOU You are a portfolio strategist. You can look across multiple markets, identify the few challenges and opportunities that matter most, and translate them into a clear direction for the organization. You are a leader of leaders. You create clarity and set a high bar. You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and dive in when necessary.. You are deeply consumer and culture focused but equally comfortable with business performance and data. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and can create structure and direction without waiting for every answer to be available. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.</p> <p><strong>The Role: Senior Copywriter</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a senior writer, to work on one of the world’s leading car groups – covering a range of brands on their roster.</p> <p>The ideal candidate needs to be a conceptually sound creative with a history of big ideas. You will collaborate closely with marketing specialists, content strategists, and designers to create click-worthy email campaigns, persuasive marketing messages, and compelling CRM content. This role requires a keen understanding of customer behaviour and excellent copywriting skills.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drafting and editing high-quality CRM content for newsletters, emails, landing pages, and other digital platforms</li> <li>Collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve content strategy and drive customer engagement</li> <li>Analysing customer data to understand audience needs and preferences</li> <li>Ensuring brand consistency in style and adhering to tone of voice in all CRM communications.</li> <li>Being a brand guardian of the several different tones across the portfolio</li> <li>Being a mentor to junior/midweight writers in the team, helping them develop their copywriting.</li> <li>Presenting to and working closely with clients on copy.</li> <li>Being conceptual, creating big ideas across a number of brands in the group, that push CRM communications</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience as a Copywriter, CRM specialist, or similar role</li> <li>Excellent interpreting and adopting the writing style of our brand/s</li> <li>Proficiency in content management systems and CRM tools</li> <li>Familiarity with creating and optimizing SEO content</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining high-quality work</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expresses copy with clarity; on brand; on message and targeted to audience</li> <li>Presents ideas and copy to both the wider internal team and, occasionally, externally to clients with structure and parity</li> <li>Comprehends and understands brand continuity, brand guidelines and brand positioning</li> <li>Drives, defines and feeds back on quality of briefs, regular reviews, feedback channels, creative quality and collaboration</li> <li>Proactively identifies opportunities for creative work to be performed for clients, with guidance from seniors and directors</li> <li>Executes creative copy at the direction of the creative director</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's in it for you?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Aside from a generous annual leave allowance and pension allowances, you will have access to a whole host of other benefits and activities such as</li> <li>Life Assurance</li> <li>Permanent Health Insurance</li> <li>BUPA</li> <li>Flexible hybrid-working schedule</li> <li>Enhanced family friendly policies</li> <li>Well-being Programme</li> <li>Employee Assistance Support</li> <li>Cycle to Work Scheme</li> <li>Eye Care and Glasses Vouchers</li> <li>Season Ticket Loans</li> <li>WPP Discounts</li> <li>You will also have a clear long-term career development plan and access to our learning and development activities and online learning platforms.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion</strong></p> <p>VML is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, colour, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or physical or mental disability.
