You find the signal, you qualify it, you shape it, and you drive it forward.</p> <p>This role is as much for the person ready to step into full commercial ownership as it is for the seasoned enterprise growth operator. What we are looking for is not a specific tenure; it is a specific kind of commercial maturity.</p> <h3>Core Responsibilities</h3> <h4>Identify & Qualify:</h4> <ul> <li>Lead a defined area of Enterprise Growth, such as WPP Media, WPP Creative, GCL / Top Accounts, WPP Open / Data / AI, Enterprise Growth Architecture, Commercial Architecture or Solution Architecture and take personal accountability for everything that moves within it</li> <li>Actively identify and pursue ES growth opportunities through WPP relationships, direct client signals, agency teams, GCLs, platform opportunities, partner motions and enterprise transformation needs, not waiting for leads to come to you, but going to find them before anyone else has</li> <li>Work directly and consistently with client leaders, GCLs, agency leaders, media and creative leadership, consulting teams, partner teams and ES capability owners; building the kind of trust that means you are called first, not copied in later</li> </ul> <h4>Shape & Pursue:</h4> <ul> <li>Assess opportunity fit, revenue potential, urgency, readiness, route to client, stakeholder access, competitive context and activation requirements, with the rigour and speed to know quickly what to pursue, what to park and what to pass on</li> <li>Create clear problem statements, opportunity briefs, points of view, value hypotheses, stakeholder maps and pursuit recommendations, giving live opportunities the strategic structure and narrative they need to move forward with confidence</li> <li>Lead discovery, workshops, executive conversations, proposal direction, credentials, pilots and pitch development where needed, owning the early stages that determine whether an opportunity gains real traction or quietly loses momentum</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own & Build:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bring together ES capabilities across CRM, commerce, CX, content, data, AI, platforms, media, measurement, marketing technology and managed services; assembling the right combination of expertise around a live opportunity rather than defaulting to a generic response</li> <li>Maintain ownership of next actions and commercial momentum until the opportunity is ready for formal pursuit, activation, handoff or expansion, ensuring nothing stalls because no one was accountable for the next step</li> <li>Identify repeatable themes, playbook needs, case study requirements and market signals that help WPP Enterprise Solutions scale its growth motion, contributing to the system that makes the next opportunity easier to find, shape and win</li> </ul> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>You are a senior growth leader equally at home in a strategy conversation, a client meeting, a commercial negotiation and the execution that follows, because for you, these are not separate modes; they are the same job</li> <li>You build trust quickly with senior stakeholders and navigate complex global matrix environments without losing pace or clarity, moving across lines of authority and geography as a natural part of how you work, not as an obstacle you manage around</li> <li>You bring genuine domain fluency in one or more of media, creative, consulting, platforms, marketing technology, CRM, commerce, data, AI, content or transformation, enough to be credible in client conversations, not simply directionally informed</li> <li>You can spot opportunity patterns before they become obvious, qualify what deserves your energy and resist the temptation to turn ambiguity into internal process noise</li> <li>You are high-agency, collaborative and commercially mature, able to move across teams, create momentum and make things happen without waiting for perfect structure or explicit permission</li> </ul> <h3>What you'll need</h3> <ul> <li>You bring typically 12 to 15 or more years of experience across enterprise growth, strategic account growth, consulting, technology transformation, digital transformation, media transformation, agency leadership, enterprise sales or client leadership, with a career that has consistently placed you at the point where commercial decisions are made, not downstream of them</li> <li>You have direct experience originating or shaping opportunities with measurable revenue potential, and you can point to them specifically, not just describe them in aggregate</li> <li>You understand how enterprise clients buy transformation, technology, marketing, data, customer experience and managed services solutions, not as an academic proposition, but from having sat across the table from the people making those decisions and learned how they actually think</li> <li>Your background may have been built inside WPP operating companies, major agency networks, consulting firms, systems integrators, digital transformation firms, technology companies, media networks or platform businesses. What matters is whether that background taught you how to find opportunity, qualify it honestly and move it forward in a complex, high-pressure commercial environment</li> <li>You have a proven ability to work across senior clients and internal stakeholders across multiple disciplines and markets, and a track record that reflects genuine accountability for commercial outcomes, not just meaningful involvement in them</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB"><span lang="EN-GB">We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</span></span></span></p> <p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB">WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. 🚀 The Role We're hiring a People Performance Manager to join our Performance Service. tem is growing fast. Our goal is to get better as we get bigger - revenue growing faster than headcount. In practice that means keeping our strongest people engaged and performing, getting new joiners productive quickly, and enabling our leaders to multiply their impact over time. Most companies solve that with layers of management. We don't. Our leaders (Player-Coaches) coach their teams while staying hands-on with the work, which means the systems around them have to do more of the lifting. That's where the Performance Service comes in. We're a team of four, and we own how tem runs as an organisation: the operating rhythm (how work gets planned, tracked, escalated and reported), the onboarding and development that build capability, the frameworks that define what good performance looks like and how people progress and get paid, and the operational backbone of contracts, benefits and payroll. We don't own recruitment. We're adding a second Performance Partner because we need more hands on deck - both partnering with our leaders day to day, and building the frameworks that support them. Your patch is sustained performance - the part that runs continuously once someone is through the door. You'll carry a portfolio of leaders across our Engines and Services that you're accountable for, and you'll co-own the frameworks that sit underneath them alongside the rest of the team. You will not be handed a finished playbook to administer. You'll report into the Performance Service Manager. HR experience is welcome but not required - we're open to operators, people who've led teams, and the sort of person who ends up owning whatever the company needs next. In your first 12 months, you might: Become the first call for a portfolio of leaders on anything to do with their people - performance calls, team decisions and hard conversations. Co-design how progression, performance standards, evaluation and reward actually work at tem, alongside the rest of the Performance team. Handle live cases end to end - performance management, difficult conversations, exits and restructures. Use AI and automation so the operational layer runs itself and your time goes on judgement, not process. Turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, and measure whether they work. 🛠️ Responsibilities Coach and challenge: be a leader's first call on anything to do with their people - a decision they want a second view on, coaching on how to handle a situation, or a read on employment law - and hold a position when you disagree with them. Raise the bar: hold leaders to a high standard on performance, potential, pay and progression - help them make sharper calls, and hold consistency across your patch. Handle live cases end to end: performance management, difficult conversations, exits and restructures. Build to delight: shape how progression, performance standards, evaluation and reward actually work at tem, alongside the rest of the Performance team. We treat our people like top athletes, and our aim is to delight them at every step of their employee experience - the systems around them have to express that at every contact point. Design for our shape, not the textbook: we index on outcomes and impact in everything - how progression works, how teams are structured, what leaders spend their time on. Most standard people frameworks assume a management hierarchy we don't have. Automate the repeatable: use AI and automation so the operational layer runs itself and your time goes on judgement, not process. Think in process, scalability and iteration: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service. Measure whether they work and redesign when they don't fit the purpose. ✅ Requirements You do not need a CIPD qualification, and you do not need to have worked in a large, established HR function. You might have been a founder's associate or Chief of Staff at a Series A or B startup, holding the place together while it scaled. You might have built a People function from scratch and taken it from a one-person band to a well-oiled machine. You might have run a team or an Operations function where the people calls were effectively yours, even if People or HR never appeared in your job title. Or you might have done a different job that helped you build the skills below. A background in HR might help you do this job well, but it is not a requirement. Must-Haves You've held real accountability for decisions on people - you've partnered with leaders, or managed a team yourself, where hiring, performance and exit calls were either yours or made on your guidance. You can be trusted with the hardest conversations in the business and you're recognised for how you handle them, and you understand how decisions about people shape culture and employer brand - balancing efficiency with empathy. You've worked in or towards building a high-performance culture, and you're a confident challenger who carries conviction and can influence leadership decisions. You're comfortable operating without a playbook, in a company where the requirements and the shape of your role change constantly. You think from first principles, get to the root cause of complex problems, weigh competing considerations and anticipate second-order consequences. You're fluent with Notion, automation and AI tooling - your instinct is to build the thing rather than do it manually a second time - and you write clearly enough that a busy person reads it once and comes away with a clear idea of the situation and the next actions. Desirable Employment relations experience in the UK, Europe or the US - we operate across the UK and Europe today, with plans to expand to the US soon. Experience working across multiple countries, including employer of record arrangements. Compensation and benchmarking experience - salary banding, pay review cycles, market data. 🎁 Benefits & Perks Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing. 🤝 Interview Process We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know. Intro call with our Talent team. Skills interview, which might include a practical exercise we may ask you to prepare in advance. Hiring Manager interview. Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. title: Electric Propulsion Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Role Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. As Electric Propulsion Engineer, you own the design of that thruster: you calculate it, design it, build it, test it in our own vacuum facilities and feed what you learn straight into the next iteration. You own the testing of your own designs, and your results decide what flies. Responsibilities Design Own the design of our RF gridded ion thruster and its performance calculations, from concept to flight configuration. Iterate rapidly to support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries. Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers on each new iteration of the ion propulsion system. Build and test Design and build the test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing. Assemble and operate test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities. Run electric propulsion tests on your own designs and analyse the results. Plan and run the test campaigns for your own designs. Verify Turn test results into design changes, then re-test. Document every test configuration and result so it gives traceable evidence for system verification and qualification. Requirements Essential Strong knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters, including RF plasma generation, ion optics and neutralisation. Hands-on electric propulsion testing, ideally with RF generators, high-voltage power supplies and thrust balances. Experience with vacuum systems (pumps, gauges, valves), power supplies, fluid management (high-pressure gas tanks, mass flow controllers) and data acquisition. Solid grounding in plasma physics, modelling, diagnostics and ionisation processes. Willingness to design, build and test your own hardware, and to work extended hours on-site. Nice to have Experience taking a thruster from design through qualification to flight hardware. Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB). Experience running thrusters on more than one propellant, such as xenon, krypton or air. We are recruiting across propulsion design and test. Apply to whichever role fits you best - strong candidates may be considered for either. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><em>At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. As a leader in the industry, Klaviyo is committed to innovation, customer success, and fostering a collaborative work environment.</p> <p>Named as one of the UK’s ‘Great Places To Work’ for the third year running, we are looking for individuals who want to join our dedicated team and help us grow our already impressive customer base in EMEA even further. </p> <p>We're seeking passionate <strong>Customer Success Professionals (CSMs)</strong> for our new state of the art and dynamic London office who thrive in a hybrid working environment (3 days in the office). Our mission is to exceed customer expectations and drive their growth. We're looking for CSMs who are dedicated to delivering the best experience to our EMEA customers.</p> <p><strong>This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a customer-first attitude, strong consultative and technical skills, and a proven track record of creatively solving unique problems in a fast-paced environment.</strong></p> <p><strong>Ideal candidates will have a strong background in CRM, Campaign Management, Data and Analytics, Digital, E-Commerce, or Marketing Technology Solutions.</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>How you will make a difference:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Transform workflows by putting AI at the centre, building smarter systems and ways of working from the ground up.</li> <li>Be passionate about customer success and establish yourself as the trusted advisor for Klaviyo’s enterprise business.</li> <li>Drive positive Net Revenue Retention by mitigating churn risk and identifying opportunities for customer expansion and upgrades.</li> <li>Devise customized success plans based on customers' goals and challenges, holding customers accountable for driving action.</li> <li>Compose strategies to increase email, SMS, and digital channel revenue for all customers through the Klaviyo platform while driving growth and expansion.</li> <li>Proactively review customer performance, address any open issues, and ensure consistent messaging and appropriate escalation.</li> <li>Keep customers up to date on product releases and new features.</li> <li>Share feedback with Product/Engineering to enhance customer engagement.</li> <li>Contribute to a positive team environment of collaboration, customer empathy, equality, and inclusion.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of customer success or account management with a track record for building and nurturing relationships with multiple stakeholders on an account at a time.</li> <li>An experienced marketer with a background in campaign management, CRM, digital marketing, data, or analytics.</li> <li>You’ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you’re excited to dive in and learn fast. You’re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient. </li> <li>Familiarity with Marketing Automation technologies.</li> <li>A proven track record of advising customers or executing marketing strategies.</li> <li>Customer success or account management experience with a history of building and nurturing relationships with multiple stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience explaining how to achieve key goals using software with end users.</li> <li>A track record of creative problem-solving for customers and end users.</li> <li>Comfortable discussing and supporting commercial conversations.</li> <li>Thrives in a collaborative environment.</li> <li>Excellent organizational and project management skills.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills via phone, video conference, and email.</li> <li>Curious and eager to learn.</li> <li>Adaptable to change and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Experience with G-Suite, Gainsight, Salesforce, or similar tools.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Hybrid </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br><br></span></p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Our salary range reflects the cost of labour in the country where the job post is advertised. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.</p> <p>In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility. </p> <p>Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE  range for your preferred location during the hiring process.</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range in Local Currency:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£72,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£108,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.</em></p> <p><strong>Get to Know Klaviyo</strong></p> <p>We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. title: Senior Manager, Marketing Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><div> <p><strong>THE WORK:</strong></p> <p>We are growing, and so is the breadth and depth of our marketing programs, with AI at the core of how we scale. We are looking for a highly motivated, diligent, and data-driven Senior Marketing Analytics Manager to join our Marketing Operations team. Reporting into the Director, Marketing Operations and Demand Generation, this role will serve as the analytical backbone of our growth marketing engine — leading the measurement, visualization, and insights infrastructure that drives smarter investment decisions and executive-level confidence in our marketing performance.</p> <p>In this role, you will own analytics and reporting across all growth marketing functions, from campaign performance to pipeline attribution. You'll partner closely with Growth Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and other cross-functional teams to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and actionable across the full funnel. title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p><strong>Help build the future of customer operations</strong></p> <p>We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><h4>📍London - Hybrid | 💰£125,000 - £145,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</h4> <p> </p> <h4>Our Payments team⭐</h4> <p>Payments is at the heart of Monzo. It’s how our customers move, receive, spend and manage their money, from cards and bank transfers to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, payment experiences in the app, and the platform infrastructure that underpins the whole bank.</p> <p>This role sits in our Payments Platform area, working most closely with our Finance Infrastructure squad. The squad sits in Payments, but partners deeply with Finance teams to build the systems, abstractions and capabilities Monzo needs to operate safely, scale efficiently, and expand into new markets. You’ll work on foundational financial infrastructure: the ledgers, data, controls, reporting, reconciliation and platform capabilities that help Monzo understand, account for and manage money across the bank.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited by complex, technical infrastructure. The work is often behind the scenes, but it’s business-critical: it helps Monzo scale, launch new products and markets, support Finance, and keep the bank running safely.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</h4> <ul> <li>Defining the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Infrastructure within Payments Platform.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.</li> <li>Moving the team from reactive delivery towards a more strategic, product-led approach, asking why we’re building things, what good looks like, and how today’s choices support Monzo’s long-term needs.</li> <li>Translating complex finance, accounting, operational and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities.</li> <li>Prioritising across competing stakeholder needs, balancing urgent delivery with long-term system health.</li> <li>Helping Monzo build financial infrastructure that can support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.</li> <li>Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.</li> <li>Bringing strong product discipline, technical curiosity and systems thinking to a space that is critical to Monzo’s future growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h4> <ul> <li>You’re a strong senior Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.</li> <li>You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.</li> <li>You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.</li> <li>You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.</li> <li>You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.</li> <li>You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p> </p> <h4>🙌 What’s in it for you</h4> <p>💰 £125,000 - £145,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ equity</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role is hybrid working from our London office</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</h4> <ul> <li>First stage - Meet with our Collective Product Director</li> <li>Second stage - Meet with our Engineering and Finance leadership</li> <li>Third stage - Product full loop</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.<br><br>#LI-HR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

In this role, you will play a key part in shifting us from AI as a productivity tool to AI as a core part of how our marketing team operates to hit its outcomes. You will lead the workstreams and build agents to transform how we produce content at scale, while supporting the adoption of AI applications more broadly across the business. Throughout, you'll unlock new AI capabilities and the systems integrations that make them work within the guardrails of a regulated, financial-services environment.</p> <p>This is a role for a first-principles and systems thinker: someone who can break a complex problem down to its fundamentals, design how the pieces fit together, and build. You'll be a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, and you'll be excellent at navigating a complex, stakeholder-heavy environment to get things done.</p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Martech & AI and sits within the Martech team, part of the Growth Collective. This is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be involved in:</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Programme management:</strong> Leading our content scaling programme including translating goals into sequenced, actionable work, driving delivery, and coordinating owners and stakeholders across a complex environment.</p> <p><strong>Building AI agents:</strong> Designing and building AI agents (using tools like Claude) to transform how we produce and scale content. This means turning repeatable, manual work into reliable, well-governed automated flows, with clear judgement on where a human stays in the loop.</p> <p><strong>Systems integration and governance:</strong> Connecting AI and agents into our martech stack and data to unlock new capabilities. This means building the integrations that make them work, and doing it safely in a regulated, financial-services environment (i.e. with data protection, compliance, and the right controls built in).</p> <p><strong>Creative AI tooling:</strong> Running discovery on creative AI tooling. This means assessing what's out there, testing what fits, and identifying where it can raise the quality and scale of our creative output.</p> <p><strong>Tooling selection and RFP:</strong> Running RFPs for Marketing tooling, particularly for a Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. This means driving a rigorous selection process from requirements through vendor evaluation to a clear, well-justified recommendation.</p> <p><strong>AI adoption across the business:</strong> Championing the adoption of AI-driven solutions beyond the programme, including helping other teams understand and apply AI, and sharing what works.</p> <p><strong>This is for you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of building and applying AI for teams. You can point to agents, automations, or AI-driven workflows you've built and shipped that others came to rely on, ideally for a marketing or content team with people and stakeholders in the mix.</li> <li>You have strong programme leadership. You've led cross-functional programmes or workstreams end to end, sequencing the work, managing dependencies and risk, keeping stakeholders aligned, and driving delivery to a successful outcome (including picking up work already in flight).</li> <li>You're a first-principles and systems thinker who can break down a complex, ambiguous problem, design how the parts fit together, and build a solution.</li> <li>You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and in complex, stakeholder-heavy environments, working with individuals at all levels to get things done.</li> <li>You have a working understanding of marketing and how content and creative are produced. You know what "good" needs to look like and how to build the right guardrails around it.</li> <li>You bring martech literacy and can run a rigorous tooling selection process. This means familiarity with the tooling, integrations, data, and vendors that make up a marketing tech stack. </li> <li>You're comfortable building and integrating AI in a regulated or high-governance environment. You design for data protection, compliance, and the right human controls from the start, not as an afterthought.</li> <li>You possess excellent communication skills, translating between the business need and the technical detail so everyone's working to the same picture.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply- even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £80,000 - £100,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p>📍 This role can be offered in a hybrid approach, working from our London office and home.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 Application journey key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Call with a member of the hiring team (30 minutes)</li> <li>Initial Call with the Hiring Manager (30 minutes)</li> <li>Case Study Review Call (45 minutes) & Behavioural interview (45 minutes)</li> <li>Final Interview with the Hiring Manager, and a member of the Marketing Leadership Team (30 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks – your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. You will act as the crucial link between our central teams and our local country Marketing Leads to set every new market up for success.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Go-to-Market Launch & Marketing: Executing and helping build a plan for Business Banking launches in new markets, including media/channel strategies, communication tactics, and integrated marketing campaigns. </li> <li>Integrated Marketing across channels: Developing and implementing marketing plans across multiple channels, including digital, social, and traditional media. </li> <li>Creative problem-solver: Working with the team to market to a new audience and find innovative ways to grow the brand. </li> <li>Tackling ambiguity: You can take away ambiguous business problems or customer challenges and come up with a plan to tackle them.</li> <li>Keeping everyone aligned: In a fast-moving expansion, you think ahead and communicate ahead of time, setting a rhythm of updates and anticipating stakeholder questions.</li> <li>Working with Creative and Media agencies: Partnering with best in class agencies and own day to day agency management. </li> <li>Media and Communications: Working in partnership with our Communications Team to execute on strategies to build brand awareness and drive engagement.</li> <li>Stakeholder Management: Working with stakeholders within Monzo to align marketing efforts with overall business objectives. </li> <li>Brand Consistency: Upholding Monzo's brand identity and values while adapting to the nuances of the local market. Ensure consistency in messaging and branding across all touchpoints.</li> <li>Reporting: Working with data teams to report frequently on key metrics, providing insights and actions.</li> <li>Regulatory Compliance: Navigating the regulatory landscape in Italy to ensure all marketing activities adhere to local regulation</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of launching new products or entering new markets, and have owned medium-sized projects that required cross-team collaboration and have delivered them successfully. </li> <li>You're hands-on and comfortable executing campaigns, building websites, and configuring CRM journeys.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in complex environments. title: General Counsel
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong>, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones, with an option to be office based in London, UK.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.</li> <li>Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.</li> <li>Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.</li> <li>Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.</li> <li>Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>Substantial senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business.</li> <li>Proven experience leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> <li>negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services</li> <li>advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience of, or demonstrable readiness for, public company governance: listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> title: Tax Senior Associate

description: <h1>Tax Senior Associate</h1> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Tax Senior Associate,</strong> reporting to the CFO. This role covers multiple Canonical corporate entities in several countries. We have a preference for candidates in EMEA time zones.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>astute and forward-thinking tax professional</strong> to build a tax function from the ground up at a profitable, fast-growing technology company. We're looking for someone with a keen interest in technology and how technology is changing the tax profession, who can translate that insight into a modern, effective strategy and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the CFO, you will <strong>design and own the tax processes</strong> that support our global expansion. Your primary challenge will be navigating the complexity of the evolving global environment in which we operate, where tax rules are constantly evolving. You will work with the CFO to establish a scalable and efficient framework fit for a dynamic, global software business—tackling everything from digital services taxes to leveraging new tax technologies.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and strategic thinking</strong> over years of experience. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, a professional qualification in accounting and tax and demonstrable exposure to global tax considerations in a multinational context.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region, or may be office based in London, UK</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Manage and coordinate the preparation and review of corporate tax, VAT, and other relevant tax returns for our entities, ensuring timely and accurate filings</li> <li>Work with external advisers to develop transfer pricing documentation and tax planning initiatives and lead their implementation</li> <li>Act as a key point of contact for tax authority audits and enquiries, preparing responses and supporting documentation in collaboration with external advisors.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to streamline and improve tax processes, controls, and data management to enhance efficiency and accuracy particularly using technology and automation</li> <li>Manage and run tax provisioning and reporting under IFRS, including calculating effective tax rates and preparing tax-related disclosures for financial statements</li> <li>Work closely with the wider finance team, legal, and business operations to provide tax support and ensure cross-functional alignment</li> <li>Monitor changes in tax legislation across the regions in which we operate and assess their potential impact on the company.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics, technology or other quantitative field</li> <li>Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA) and tax advisor (CTA, ADIT or equivalent)</li> <li>A minimum of 3-5 years of relevant tax experience, gained within a Big 4/Top 10 accounting firm or a multinational in-house tax team.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li> Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tax concepts to non-tax stakeholders</li> <li>Thoughtfulness and self-motivation</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leadership ability</li> <li>Software or tech industry experience</li> <li>Public company finance and reporting experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

title: Product Marketing Manager
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help shape how Linear’s products are brought to market and understood by customers. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design, CX, Sales, and Marketing, and is responsible for turning technically sophisticated product work into clear narratives, strong launches, and high-quality customer-facing experiences. You’ll go deep on the product, define positioning and messaging, and drive execution across the surfaces that matter most—from in-product copy and changelogs to enablement, documentation inputs, email, and launch communications. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines product judgment, excellent writing, and strong cross-functional leadership. Location & work mode Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America and the United Kingdom. You can work from anywhere within these regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.
